changeSet.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_recon_summary AS SELECT t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class, COUNT(*) AS total_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATCHED') AS matched_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('UNMATCHED','DISPUTED')) AS break_trades, COALESCE(SUM(t.quantity * t.price), 0) AS total_notional FROM trades t JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.id = t.counterparty_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class;
-- UNIQUE INDEX required for REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_daily_recon_summary ON mv_daily_recon_summary (trade_date, region, asset_class);

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_daily_recon_summary;
